reviews.text: Absolutely loved the grooming service! They handled my puppy with so much care, and the results look incredible. I’m so happy with how everything turned out.

Brought my little sammy to be groomed. Ensor was very professional, informative and was completely beyond my expectations. They took the time to explain all the processes and equipment that will used. The extra effort helped me confidently leave my pup in their care and set my heart at ease. I would highly recommend seeking out Ensor for grooming.

My dog is pretty nervous with new people but the staff here are very patient and they do a great job with him. We've gone monthly since they've opened and I'm glad we found someone that my dog trusts too.
First time bringing my Cavapoo in for grooming and they did a great job! Everyone there is very friendly and nice. They took great care of her and she looks so cute! Would definitely recommend!
Bunny was handsome and happy after the grooming ~

My fiancé and I have gone to Bubble Bark twice now and had a wonderful experience both times!
During the first appointment, we were worried about Lillie’s first time grooming, but they did an incredible job at ensuring she was comfortable and felt safe.
After her second appointment, Lillie was cared for thoroughly and left happy!
10/10 would recommend Bubble Bark!!

I had an amazing experience with Bubble Bark Grooming! The team was incredibly caring, patient, and attentive with my dog, which gave me so much peace of mind. You can tell they genuinely love animals and take the time to make sure they’re comfortable throughout the grooming process.

The groom turned out even better than I expected, my puppy looked absolutely adorable and so well cared for. The attention to detail was outstanding, and the overall service was friendly and professional from start to finish.

I had such a great experience with Bubble Bark grooming! 🫧 My dog, Milk Tea is very nervous and shy around new people, but the groomer was super patient, gentle, and caring throughout the whole appointment. They took the time to make my dog feel comfortable and never rushed anything.
I also really appreciated all the helpful recommendations and advice they shared with me about grooming and caring for my dog at home. You can tell they genuinely care about the pets they work with. 🐶 Milk Tea came home looking amazing and much more relaxed than I expected. Highly recommend Bubble Bark to anyone looking for a professional and compassionate groomer! 🫶🏻🩵🥰
Knowledgeable and considerate staff! My dog had a great experience here 🐶✨ …

Just brought my 8 month old to Bubble Bark for grooming. Highly recommend any pet owners who need service to check this place out. Ensor did a great job with the cut and took good care of my puppy. Definitely coming back again 10/10!

I had a wonderful experience at Bubble Bark Dog Grooming! The team was incredibly friendly, professional, and genuinely caring toward my dog. From the moment we walked in, they made both of us feel comfortable and welcomed.

The grooming was done beautifully—my dog came out looking clean, well-trimmed, and happy. You can really tell they pay attention to detail and take pride in their work. I also appreciated how they handled my dog with patience and care throughout the entire process.

Highly recommend Bubble Bark to anyone looking for a trustworthy and high-quality grooming service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

We found our dog grooming place! It’s Carly’s first grooming session after she moved here in Canada and it did not disappoint! Took me time to find a safe place, and here it is! The owner take such good care of Carly, he made sure there was an ample enough time to get to know Carly and feel comfortable in the place, he plays with her and put so much attention to her. I really appreciate it!
He also sent a before and after photo for some glow up proof! ✨

Ooops, thank you also for the discount you extended for Carly!! 💓
Highly recommend. Very patient with lots of questions.

I wanted to express my sincere gratitude to the team. My dog has anxiety and was really upset by the previous groomer. I think this is the first time my dog has come out of the room happily, not rushing to leave the store. They’ve treated my dog so nicely and patiently. I’ll definitely be coming here regularly!
The team is very kind and attentive, they really care about their customers and are absolutely amazing with dogs! The atmosphere is clean and professional. Highly recommend this place!
The Bubble Bark Grooming Team was absolutely amazing! 🥰 I would recommend them without hesitation! …

Last Sunday, my sister's little cutie went to Bubble Bark for a full grooming session. Thanks to all the ladies for their patient guidance; I haven't had such a fresh and clean headshot in ages! Thanks for sharing! 🫶🏻 …

Thank you so much for inviting us to your Grand Opening and for giving Bumble Bee another wonderful experience at Bubble Bark!

The owner was incredibly thoughtful and even prepared a lovely goodie bag for Bumble Bee. Every item inside was so considerate and useful for dog owners. You can truly see how much care and love they put into thinking about every client and their pets.

Ensor and Iris are simply the best at taking care of all our little buddies. I love how they treat every dog like their friend. The opening party was so warm and welcoming, with food and drinks prepared for everyone. It really showed how mindful and considerate they are toward dog owners as well.

I honestly regret not bringing more of my friends to come and enjoy this lovely moment and the kindness they share with everyone.

I would definitely recommend everyone to bring their pets here. I can see how much Bumble Bee enjoys coming back to Bubble Bark, and we will absolutely be returning again!

Honestly the best grooming store in the city!! The environment is very clean, new, and well maintained, which immediately made me feel comfortable bringing my dog. The staff were professional, patient, and did an amazing job with the grooming. They trimmed my dog’s fur really well, and I was pleased with the result. What impressed me the most was that my dog is usually very timid, but was surprisingly happy and relaxed there. That really shows how gentle and caring the staff are. Highly recommend!
The care and passion they show with every dog that comes in is amazing! Would definitely recommend .
Great grooming service! The staff were very friendly and patient to my fami. The haircut looked amazing and fami came back clean and really cute!

I am ecstatic to have found Bubble Bark. My wife and I have been looking for a groomer in our area for our 3 year old golden retriever who can be fussy at times. The staff were unbelievably patient and reassured us throughout the entire process. I am amazed with how clean and well organized the facilities were. Would recommend bringing your furry little family member here any day of the week. A+++ Thank you again to all the staff at Bubble Bark for making this experience an easy and memorable one for us!
I was there on the grand opening and it was amazing! The dogs looked amazing and the owners are the sweetest.
My baby look so clean after the grooming yesterday with the Grand Opening essential groom! Friendly staff and clean environment !

I’ve been coming here since their soft opening and purposefully waited until their official Grand Opening on March 8th to post this review because Iris and Ensor truly deserve all the praise!

My 10-month-old mini Goldendoodle, Changsik, is a typical energetic puppy around people but is actually quite shy and easily spooked by other dogs or loud noises. I was honestly worried about how he’d handle the grooming environment and the sound of the machines.

It turns out I had nothing to worry about! Changsik absolutely loves the place. The owners, Iris and Ensor, are so incredibly patient. Ensor even mentioned that Changsik was so relaxed he actually fell asleep during his shower and trim! It’s such a relief to know he feels that safe and comfortable in her care.

Regarding the cut: I only gave Ensor a few vague reference photos, but she nailed it. She went above and beyond, giving me honest, professional advice on how to shape the cut to suit a Goldendoodle’s specific coat type and how to make him look his best.

Iris and Ensor don't just treat us like another appointment; they treat us like friends. The location is also very convenient—right near Joyce and Kingsway—and there are plenty of parking spots, which makes drop-offs and pick-ups seamless. I’m attaching a few photos from the Grand Opening—the goodie bags were such a thoughtful touch! If you're looking for a professional groomer who truly understands and cares for dogs, this is the spot.
Highly recommend Bubble Bark! Everyone is so friendly and the salon is so clean! Enza is so patient and loving with the dogs, she does a fantastic job. My boy Floyd absolutely adores her!

We wanted to support a new neighbourhood business so booked our dog in for a groom. When my husband called them for an appointment, he asked for a haircut and the person on the phone suggested the essential groom package, which includes an ‘all over length tidy’. He also paid a $30 deposit (this is meant to be used for a future groom).

Fast forward, he went to drop our dog off and Bubble Bark even asked my husband if he wanted a short trim and my husband said yes.

When we picked our dog up, I noticed that he did not get trimmed at all so we brought him back and was told that the master groomer does not believe in cutting Pomeranian fur. I understand that they are looking out for a Pomeranian coat but then why didn’t we get a phone call or get a different price for a service we did not receive? They told us to come later in the day for them to do a trim.

We brought him back again later 4 hours later so they can fix it but then was told that would be another extra charge because it would’ve been a big job. I was pretty upset by their efforts in making it right. I just wasn’t happy with the results. After an exchange of texts, they gave us a refund but kept the $30 deposit. We are not going to return so we are losing out on $30. If you’re a Pomeranian owner, don’t expect a proper trim but you’ll definitely be paying a lot for a bath and nail trim.

Bubble Bark is such a great addition to the community! The team is professional, caring, and clearly passionate about what they do. The space is clean and well organized, and you can tell they prioritize the comfort and safety of every dog. You also can’t beat the price! Highly recommend for anyone looking for reliable, quality grooming services.

Bubble Bark was recommended by a friend and we're so happy we decided to switch groomers!

Leo looked so cute after his spa day! He got so many compliments 🥰 Leo has some separation anxiety but Ensor and Iris were so patient making sure he was comfortable before starting.

They walked me through the whole process which put me at ease and even gave me advice on how to better take care of Leo at home. Highly recommend bringing your pet here! Leo approved 🐶

This grooming shop is truly the best place for my puppy! He used to be very scared whenever I took him to grooming appointments, but after his first visit here, everything changed. Now he gets excited every time we go! As a pet parent, that means the world to me. The groomer is professional, friendly, and incredibly welcoming. He was so patient and gentle when my puppy felt nervous about the brush and trimmer. I’m so grateful we found this place!!!

I highly recommend Bubble Bark! It’s truly a wonderful dog grooming salon. The groomer is incredibly caring, patient, and attentive. My dog is quite shy and nervous about bath time, but they made him feel completely safe and comfortable throughout the whole process.

When I picked him up, he looked so neat and clean, and his coat was shiny and beautifully groomed. You can really tell they put their heart into their work.

Bubble Bark provides such a safe, calm, and comfortable environment for your fur baby. I’m so happy and grateful that I found this place for my dog. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a trustworthy groomer!
Wonderful service! Very caring and clean facility
First time bringing my 6 month old puppy and they took great care of him! Amazing groomers and customer service! Highly recommend!

Can’t say enough good things about Bubble Bark! I actually misread my schedule and showed up a week early, but they were super kind and still took my puppy in without any hesitation.

My pup is only about 4.5 months old, so I was a bit worried he’d be nervous in a new place. But Enso and the team made him feel completely at home. I’ve honestly never seen him this relaxed at a grooming spot before.

They also took the time to walk us through everything—from drop-off, letting the puppy settle and relax, to how the grooming session would go. You can really tell they care and don’t rush the process.

Even though they’re newly opened, I’d 100% trust them with any pet. They treated my puppy with so much care and heart. Will definitely be coming back!

Really impressed with the service and care provided by the team at Bubble Bark! I took my 8.5 month, high energy, standard poodle Moon to them for the first time and he had a great experience! They took their time with his first visit to make sure he was comfortable and could take breaks during the groom. It was clear that they really care for dogs and even informed me of a couple skin issues he was having that I wasn’t aware of! They also chatted with me about upkeep in between appointments, which, as a new poodle parent still learning the brushing ropes, was very helpful!

Moon came out looking so good and dare I say even better than he did with his previous groomer! Highly recommend Bubble Bark for their care, attention to detail, and calm, clean environment!

Absolutely love this place! The groomer truly puts the pet’s comfort first, and you can feel the difference. My pet came back calm, relaxed, and genuinely happy, not stressed at all. The care and attention they give is amazing, and the grooming was perfect. I trust them completely and highly recommend!

I had such a wonderful experience here! The staff did an amazing job grooming my dog — you can truly tell they are very skilled and incredibly patient with pets.

After the grooming, my dog came out so fluffy and clean , literally like a little fur teddy bear 🧸! I loved the result so much and was extremely satisfied.

Most importantly, I could really feel that my dog enjoyed the whole process and the atmosphere. My dog seemed relaxed and comfortable, which shows how trustworthy and caring the owner and staff are. As a pet parent, that made me feel very reassured and confident leaving my dog in their hands.

The pricing is also very reasonable, with excellent value for the quality of service — truly great value for money.

I will definitely come back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for professional and loving pet grooming services🧡

I had a wonderful experience at Bubble Bark Dog Grooming! From booking to pick-up, everything was smooth and professional. The staff were incredibly patient and gentle, making my dog feel comfortable and well cared for throughout the grooming process.

The shop was clean and welcoming, and the grooming result exceeded my expectations — my dog came out looking neat, fluffy, and smelling amazing. You can really tell they care about both the dogs and the quality of their work.

Great service, fair pricing, and a stress-free experience for my pup. I will definitely be coming back and would highly recommend this place to other dog owners!

I brought my short-haired chihuahua here and they were very patient and attentive to her. They will ask you if your fur baby has any anxieties and patiently work to reassure them before every step of the procedure. Don’t expect a rush job because it is more of a spa experience than a basic bath but worth it. My fur baby came out smelling sweet and relaxed. Thanks, Bubble Bark!

The salon is impeccably clean. The owner is amazing - kind, knowledgeable, and focused on the dogs’ wellness and comfort. One of my dogs is quite anxious but she knows how to build trust and keep him calm. Best groomer I’ve been to. Oh! And check out how happy they are and the cute crocheted collars they came home in!

Brought my family’s dog for a groom here and the owner treated him with care and class. She is so professional during the process that I could tell our family’s cutie pie enjoyed his little bathing session to wrap up his 2025❤️ Thank you for walking the extra mile in the owners’ perspective! Highly recommend!

Bubble Bark is hands down one of the best dog grooming salons in Vancouver! The team is incredibly friendly, patient, and genuinely cares about the dogs they work with. You can tell they treat every pup like their own.

My dog Tiger came back looking amazing and, more importantly, calm and happy — which really shows how well they’re handled. The grooming was clean, detailed, and done with so much care and love.

The space is clean, professional, and very welcoming. Highly recommend Bubble Bark to any dog parent looking for a trustworthy, high-quality grooming experience in Vancouver. Tiger and I will definitely be back!

I had a wonderful experience at Bubble Bark . The staff were warm, gentle, and incredibly patient with Mocha and Coco (my fur babies). They took the time to listen to what I wanted and made sure my pup felt comfortable throughout the entire visit.
The grooming was done beautifully—they came out looking clean, fresh, and so adorable. I really appreciated the attention to detail and how professional the team was.
The facility is clean, organized, and clearly run by people who love animals. I highly recommend Bubble Bark to anyone looking for a safe and caring place for their pet babies. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Brought my puppy to Bubbe Bark for his first grooming session, and he absolutely loved it. Never seen him so calm and relaxed. Loved the connection he built with the groomer. Service was top notch. Already booked for next session as soon as we were done with the first one. We are so excited for my dog to have an amazing groomer for rest of his life! Thank you!

I brought my newly adopted dog Professor to Bubble Bark Dog Grooming. It was amazing experience. It is clear the staff love dogs and treated him with a lot of care. I would highly recommend Bubble Bark Dog Grooming for anyone looking for a kind and trustworthy groomer!

It was my first time taking my dog (Babbu) to a full grooming session. Made my dog feel very comfortable despite being very shy. I loved the in depth explanation given for the service. I will definitely come back with Babbu!

The service here is amazing
I’ve gone to many bars for my pug Timothy and usually I am disappointed however this has exceeded my expectations
The owner is extremely professional and kind and I appreciate that
Timothy was very happy with the Grooming
Thank you I will be back soon
The owner were rlly niceee. They're very patient with my dog Nyunyu and the environment is clean n tidy.

One of the best experience that I have ever had.
My puppy was extremely happy and comfortable the entire service. Highly recommended.

Tofu had a great experience at bubble bark.
The team was very gentle and responsible on every part of the grooming service.
Highly recommended for your beautiful dogs.

My dog Bagel, a very energetic poodle, had a wonderful grooming experience at Bubble Bark. The groomer handled him so well, kept him calm, and made sure he felt comfortable throughout the whole session. I’m really happy with the result and will definitely be coming back next time!

Took my dog to Bubble Bark for a bath and had a great experience. The shop is clean, and the staff are very loving and patient. My dog came out smelling fresh and looking super fluffy. Reasonable price and excellent service, will definitely come back!

Brought my dog in for a full grooming, and was very pleased with the work that was done! My dog constantly runs away from the dryer, but the owner was able to get him to remain calm and be still. The owner is very professional, but at the same time made the experience fun and enjoyable. Had such an amazing experience, and will absolutely be coming back again for more services!

I brought Hachi in for a groom but was skeptical. My dog is playful and active. She also dislikes the dryer. Boy, was I surprised! Hachi loved her spa day! The groomer connected with Hachi so well and got her comfortable. Being a golden retriever, Hachi required a special kind of grooming style and Bubble bark nailed it! She looked cute as ever!!! I cannot recommend Bubble Bark enough. This is the Best dog grooming salon I have tried in years. Thank you for a wonderful experience:)
Amazing experience! My dog felt so comfortable I will definitely be coming back 🐶 …

Grooming my 9 month old doodle is definitely not an easy task; as she is sensitive to everything and yet the groomer here nailed the job. She is very detail and patient with my puppy. She takes time for the puppy to familiarize the environment before doing the actual work. She even provided a report after grooming to document all the findings and tips for better home caring. Price is also fair. Highly recommending this place.

I brought my dog Nori (8 month old corgi ) here for a full grooming session, and the owner took such amazing care of him! She was so kind and attentive, and even noticed a small patch of eczema that we hadn’t realized. I really appreciated how patient she was in helping Nori get comfortable in a new environment. You can tell she truly loves dogs and pays great attention to detail. Highly recommend! 🐶✨

Also, this is the photo she took for us, it’s so adorable!!!
